activities.title: Merge your invitation to 3 people
activities.intro: Work in your own word processor and spreadsheet. Use sample names only. Tick each step as you finish it.

items: In a spreadsheet, type Name, Position, Section, Email in row 1, then 3 sample people in rows 2 to 4. Save as Workshop Invitees and close it.
Open your invitation letter from Topic 2.3.
Mailings › Start Mail Merge › Letters, then Select Recipients › Use an Existing List.
Replace the typed name with Insert Merge Field › Name. Add Position and Section.
Preview Results and click through all 3.
Finish & Merge › Edit Individual Documents › All. Save the new file as Merged Invitations.
